description.value:
You gain proficiency with blaster pistols, blaster rifles, ion pistols, ion rifles, and the lightbow—together your Whills weapons, which count as monk weapons for you. While wielding one, you gain the following:

  • Your Whills weapons count as melee weapons, dealing kinetic damage equal to your Martial Arts damage die when used in melee.
  • Whenever you would make an unarmed strike as part of your Martial Arts bonus action or your Flurry of Blows, you may instead attack with a Whills weapon you're wielding, rolling a d4 in place of its normal damage (this die grows with your monk level, following the Martial Arts column of the monk table).
  • Whenever you would make a ranged attack with a Whills weapon, you may instead reload it.
